decisions.reason: It closely builds on the firm's existing glass-silicon and through-via capabilities, so its own R&D and EU project experience enable the firm to assimilate early results and improve the product.
Copper interposer glass wafers extend the firm's established wafer metallization and packaging know-how and are a strategic focus, giving high absorptive capacity to learn and apply improvements.
The off-the-shelf brand is almost identical to the firm's core glass and quartz wafer business, so the firm can readily recognize, assimilate, and commercially apply any learning.

Distant from the firm's established wafer processing and lacking related circuit-board integration knowledge, the firm has weak absorptive capacity to interpret early results and improve the product, so management drops it.
